column1: 1. Export Cash records from WebClerk (wcapi) for the period and paste into the CASH RECORDS section below.
2. Import your bank statement CSV (use Statement Sorter at webclerk.com/sort/ to pre-sort) and paste into the BANK STATEMENT section.
3. Match transactions: enter the Bank Line # in the Match column of each Cash record, or the Cash ida in the Match column of each Bank line.
4. Review the SUMMARY section at the bottom. Unmatched items need investigation.
5. When complete, save and upload to WebClerk library for your records.
